questions.explanation:
Compounds which dissolve in both acids and bases are known as amphoteric oxides.

Amphoteric oxides are :

Cr2O3, BeO, SnO, SnO2, ZnO, Al2O3 , PbO and PbO2 Whereas, NO is a neutral oxide, B2O3 is an acidic oxide and CrO is a basic oxide.
